```{r}
try({
## =====================================================================
## Recompute Table 1
## =====================================================================

options(
  digits = 15,
  scipen = 999,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

K <- 9
alpha_values <- c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01)

stopifnot(
  length(K) == 1L,
  is.finite(K),
  K > 0,
  all(is.finite(alpha_values)),
  all(alpha_values > 0),
  all(alpha_values < 1)
)


## =====================================================================
## General utilities
## =====================================================================

safe_value <- function(f, ...) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      value <- f(...)

      if (length(value) != 1L || is.na(value) || !is.finite(value)) {
        Inf
      } else {
        value
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Evaluation error: ", conditionMessage(e))
      Inf
    },
    warning = function(w) {
      message("Evaluation warning: ", conditionMessage(w))
      Inf
    }
  )
}


smallest_integer_strictly_above <- function(x, tol = 1e-9) {
  stopifnot(
    length(x) == 1L,
    is.finite(x)
  )

  nearest_integer <- round(x)

  if (abs(x - nearest_integer) <= tol * max(1, abs(x))) {
    as.integer(nearest_integer + 1)
  } else {
    as.integer(floor(x) + 1)
  }
}


first_true_integer <- function(condition,
                               lower = 1L,
                               upper = 2L,
                               maximum = .Machine$integer.max) {
  lower <- as.integer(lower)
  upper <- as.integer(max(upper, lower))

  is_true <- function(n) {
    result <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(
        condition(as.integer(n))
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Condition evaluation failed at n = ",
          n,
          ": ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        FALSE
      }
    )

    isTRUE(result)
  }

  if (is_true(lower)) {
    return(lower)
  }

  while (!is_true(upper)) {
    if (upper >= maximum) {
      stop("No finite threshold was found before `maximum`.")
    }

    lower <- upper

    upper <- min(
      maximum,
      as.integer(2 * as.double(upper))
    )
  }

  ## Invariant:
  ## condition(lower) is FALSE
  ## condition(upper) is TRUE

  while (as.double(upper) - as.double(lower) > 1) {
    middle <- as.integer(
      floor(
        (
          as.double(lower) +
            as.double(upper)
        ) / 2
      )
    )

    if (is_true(middle)) {
      upper <- middle
    } else {
      lower <- middle
    }
  }

  upper
}


## =====================================================================
## Threshold for q1
## =====================================================================

U_value <- function(eta, a, alpha, K) {
  2 * K *
    (a / (a - 1))^2 *
    log(1 / (alpha * eta))
}


V_value <- function(eta, a, alpha) {
  2 * (1 + a) *
    (
      1 +
        log(2 / (alpha * (1 - eta)))
    )
}


eta_star_given_a <- function(a, alpha, K) {
  stopifnot(
    length(a) == 1L,
    is.finite(a),
    a > 1,
    alpha > 0,
    alpha < 1,
    K > 0
  )

  difference <- function(eta) {
    U_value(
      eta = eta,
      a = a,
      alpha = alpha,
      K = K
    ) -
      V_value(
        eta = eta,
        a = a,
        alpha = alpha
      )
  }

  ## Avoid machine-precision endpoints.
  lower <- 1e-12
  upper <- 1 - 1e-12

  f_lower <- difference(lower)
  f_upper <- difference(upper)

  if (
    is.finite(f_lower) &&
    is.finite(f_upper) &&
    sign(f_lower) != sign(f_upper)
  ) {
    return(
      uniroot(
        f = difference,
        lower = lower,
        upper = upper,
        tol = 1e-12,
        maxiter = 1000L
      )$root
    )
  }

  ## Fallback: directly minimize max(U, V).
  objective <- function(logit_eta) {
    eta <- plogis(logit_eta)

    max(
      U_value(
        eta = eta,
        a = a,
        alpha = alpha,
        K = K
      ),
      V_value(
        eta = eta,
        a = a,
        alpha = alpha
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- optimize(
    f = objective,
    interval = c(-30, 30),
    tol = 1e-12
  )

  plogis(fit$minimum)
}


N_given_log_a_minus_one <- function(s, alpha, K) {
  ## Prevent exp(s) from overflowing.
  if (!is.finite(s) || s > 700) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  a_minus_one <- exp(s)

  if (!is.finite(a_minus_one) || a_minus_one <= 0) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  a <- 1 + a_minus_one

  ## For very negative s, floating-point arithmetic may give a == 1.
  if (!is.finite(a) || a <= 1) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  eta <- eta_star_given_a(
    a = a,
    alpha = alpha,
    K = K
  )

  result <- max(
    U_value(
      eta = eta,
      a = a,
      alpha = alpha,
      K = K
    ),
    V_value(
      eta = eta,
      a = a,
      alpha = alpha
    )
  )

  if (length(result) != 1L || !is.finite(result)) {
    Inf
  } else {
    result
  }
}

N_star <- function(alpha, K, tol = 1e-10) {
  objective <- function(s) {
    N_given_log_a_minus_one(
      s = s,
      alpha = alpha,
      K = K
    )
  }

  ## a = 1 + exp(s).
  ## The interval [-20, 20] covers a - 1 from approximately
  ## 2e-9 to 4.9e8, which is much wider than needed here.
  fit <- optimize(
    f = objective,
    interval = c(-20, 20),
    tol = tol
  )

  if (!is.finite(fit$objective)) {
    stop(
      "Optimization of N_star failed for alpha = ",
      alpha,
      " and K = ",
      K,
      "."
    )
  }

  s_star <- fit$minimum
  a_star <- 1 + exp(s_star)

  eta_star <- eta_star_given_a(
    a = a_star,
    alpha = alpha,
    K = K
  )

  U_star <- U_value(
    eta = eta_star,
    a = a_star,
    alpha = alpha,
    K = K
  )

  V_star <- V_value(
    eta = eta_star,
    a = a_star,
    alpha = alpha
  )

  list(
    N_star = max(U_star, V_star),
    a_star = a_star,
    eta_star = eta_star,
    U_star = U_star,
    V_star = V_star,
    balance_error = abs(U_star - V_star),
    optimization_objective = fit$objective
  )
}


n_star_q1 <- function(alpha, K) {
  fit <- N_star(alpha, K)

  c(
    n = smallest_integer_strictly_above(fit$N_star),
    N_star = fit$N_star,
    a_star = fit$a_star,
    eta_star = fit$eta_star,
    balance_error = fit$balance_error
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## DGG bound
## =====================================================================

## Replace the body of this function by the updated DGG bound.
##
## It must return one finite, nonnegative numeric value.

delta_DGG <- function(n, K) {
  BoundEdgeworth::Bound_EE1(
    n = n, K4 = K,
    setup = list(continuity = FALSE, iid = TRUE, no_skewness = FALSE))
}


## Alternatively, place delta_DGG() in a separate file:
##
## source("delta_DGG.R")


## =====================================================================
## Shevtsova bound
## =====================================================================

delta_S <- function(n, K) {
  stopifnot(
    length(n) == 1L,
    n > 0,
    length(K) == 1L,
    K > 0
  )

  K_three_quarters <- K^(3 / 4)

  min(
    0.3031 * (K_three_quarters + 0.646) / sqrt(n),
    0.3322 * (K_three_quarters + 0.429) / sqrt(n),
    0.33554 * (K_three_quarters + 0.415) / sqrt(n),
    0.469 * K_three_quarters / sqrt(n)
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## PB(n, K)
## =====================================================================

PB_objective <- function(par, n, K) {
  x <- plogis(par[1L])
  y <- plogis(par[2L])

  term_1 <- (K - 1) / (sqrt(n) * x^2)

  term_2 <- 4 * sqrt(K) / ( sqrt(27) * y * sqrt(1 - y) )

  term_3 <- ( K^(3 / 4) + sqrt(K - 1) * (sqrt(K) + sqrt(3 + K / n))
  ) / ( 2 * y * ( 1 - x + sqrt(1 - x) ) )

  term_1 + term_2 + term_3
}


PB <- function(n, K, start = c(0, 0)) {
  stopifnot(
    length(n) == 1L,
    n > 0,
    length(K) == 1L,
    K >= 1
  )

  fit <- optim(
    par = start,
    fn = PB_objective,
    n = n,
    K = K,
    method = "BFGS",
    control = list(
      reltol = 1e-12,
      maxit = 2000L
    )
  )

  if (fit$convergence != 0L || !is.finite(fit$value)) {
    fit <- optim(
      par = start,
      fn = PB_objective,
      n = n,
      K = K,
      method = "Nelder-Mead",
      control = list(
        reltol = 1e-12,
        maxit = 10000L
      )
    )
  }

  if (fit$convergence != 0L || !is.finite(fit$value)) {
    stop(
      "Optimization of PB(n, K) failed for n = ",
      n,
      " and K = ",
      K,
      "."
    )
  }
  
  grid_size = 100

  xy_grid <- expand.grid(
    x = seq(0.001, 0.999, length.out = grid_size),
    y = seq(0.001, 0.999, length.out = grid_size)
  )

  xy_grid$PB <- apply(
    xy_grid,
    MARGIN = 1,
    FUN = PB_objective,
    n = n,
    K = K
  )

  minimum <- min(xy_grid$PB)
  # 
  # minimum_row <- xy_grid[
  #   which.min(xy_grid$PB),
  #   ,
  #   drop = FALSE
  # ]
  # 
  # list(
  #   minimum = minimum,
  #   minimizer = minimum_row,
  #   grid = xy_grid
  # )

  min(fit$value, minimum)
}


## =====================================================================
## Threshold for q2
## =====================================================================

qtilde_2 <- function(a, alpha, n, K) {
  if (!is.finite(a) || a <= 1) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  remainder <- exp(-n * (1 - 1 / a)^2 / (2 * K)) / 2

  probability <- 1 - alpha / 2 +
    min(delta_DGG(n, K), delta_S(n, K)) +
    remainder

  if (
    !is.finite(probability) ||
      probability <= 0 ||
      probability >= 1
  ) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  sqrt(a) * qnorm(probability)
}


minimum_qtilde_2 <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  objective <- function(s) {
    a <- 1 + exp(s)

    result <- suppressWarnings(
      qtilde_2(
        a = a,
        alpha = alpha,
        n = n,
        K = K
      )
    )

    if (
      length(result) != 1L ||
        is.na(result) ||
        !is.finite(result)
    ) {
      return(Inf)
    }

    result
  }

  ## Search over a = 1 + exp(s).
  ## This is only used to find the finite region and a suitable
  ## interval for the subsequent one-dimensional optimization.
  s_grid <- seq(
    from = -20,
    to = 20,
    length.out = 401L
  )

  objective_grid <- vapply(
    s_grid,
    objective,
    numeric(1L)
  )

  finite_indices <- which(is.finite(objective_grid))

  if (length(finite_indices) == 0L) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  ## Grid point with the smallest finite objective.
  best_index <- finite_indices[
    which.min(objective_grid[finite_indices])
  ]

  ## Construct a local interval around the best grid point.
  left_index <- max(1L, best_index - 2L)
  right_index <- min(length(s_grid), best_index + 2L)

  lower <- s_grid[left_index]
  upper <- s_grid[right_index]

  ## optimize() may evaluate points where the objective is infinite.
  ## That is legitimate, so its corresponding warning is suppressed.
  fit <- suppressWarnings(
    optimize(
      f = objective,
      interval = c(lower, upper),
      tol = 1e-10
    )
  )

  candidates <- c(
    objective_grid[best_index],
    objective(lower),
    objective(upper),
    fit$objective
  )

  candidates <- candidates[is.finite(candidates)]

  if (length(candidates) == 0L) {
    Inf
  } else {
    min(candidates)
  }
}


q2_is_finite <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  minimum <- minimum_qtilde_2(
    alpha = alpha,
    n = n,
    K = K
  )

  is.finite(minimum) &&
    minimum < sqrt(n)
}


n_star_q2 <- function(alpha, K) {
  first_true_integer(
    condition = function(n) {
      q2_is_finite(
        alpha = alpha,
        n = n,
        K = K
      )
    },
    lower = 1L,
    upper = 128L
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## Threshold for q3
## =====================================================================

r_nK <- function(n, K) {
  PB(n, K) / sqrt(n) +
    min(
      delta_DGG(n, K) +
        0.092 * K^(3 / 4) / sqrt(n),
      delta_S(n, K)
    )
}


qtilde_3 <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  probability <- 1 - alpha / 2 +
    r_nK(n, K)

  if (
    !is.finite(probability) ||
      probability <= 0 ||
      probability >= 1
  ) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  qnorm(probability)
}


q3_is_finite <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  value <- qtilde_3(
    alpha = alpha,
    n = n,
    K = K
  )

  is.finite(value) &&
    value < sqrt(n)
}


n_star_q3 <- function(alpha, K) {
  first_true_integer(
    condition = function(n) {
      q3_is_finite(
        alpha = alpha,
        n = n,
        K = K
      )
    },
    lower = 1L,
    upper = 1024L
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## Threshold for q4
## =====================================================================

qtilde_4 <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  probability <- 1 - alpha / 2 +
    25 * K^(3 / 4) / sqrt(n)

  if (
    !is.finite(probability) ||
      probability <= 0 ||
      probability >= 1
  ) {
    return(Inf)
  }

  qnorm(probability)
}


q4_is_finite <- function(alpha, n, K) {
  value <- qtilde_4(
    alpha = alpha,
    n = n,
    K = K
  )

  is.finite(value) &&
    value < sqrt(n)
}


n_star_q4 <- function(alpha, K) {
  first_true_integer(
    condition = function(n) {
      q4_is_finite(
        alpha = alpha,
        n = n,
        K = K
      )
    },
    lower = 1L,
    upper = 1024L
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## Compute Table 1
## =====================================================================

q1_details <- lapply(
  alpha_values,
  n_star_q1,
  K = K
)

q1_thresholds <- vapply(
  q1_details,
  function(x) {
    unname(x["n"])
  },
  numeric(1L)
)

q2_thresholds <- vapply(
  alpha_values,
  n_star_q2,
  K = K,
  FUN.VALUE = integer(1L)
)

q3_thresholds <- vapply(
  alpha_values,
  n_star_q3,
  K = K,
  FUN.VALUE = integer(1L)
)

q4_thresholds <- vapply(
  alpha_values,
  n_star_q4,
  K = K,
  FUN.VALUE = integer(1L)
)

table_1 <- data.frame(
  alpha_percent = 100 * alpha_values,
  q1 = as.integer(q1_thresholds),
  q2 = as.integer(q2_thresholds),
  q3 = as.integer(q3_thresholds),
  q4 = as.integer(q4_thresholds),
  check.names = FALSE
)

names(table_1) <- c(
  "alpha_percent",
  "q1_finite",
  "q2_finite",
  "q3_finite",
  "q4_finite"
)

print(
  table_1,
  row.names = FALSE
)


## =====================================================================
## Consistency checks
## =====================================================================

check_integer_threshold <- function(n_star, condition, name) {
  if (!isTRUE(condition(n_star))) {
    stop(
      name,
      " is not finite at the reported threshold n = ",
      n_star,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    n_star > 1L &&
      isTRUE(condition(n_star - 1L))
  ) {
    stop(
      name,
      " is already finite at n = ",
      n_star - 1L,
      "."
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}


for (j in seq_along(alpha_values)) {
  alpha <- alpha_values[j]

  ## q1 check
  q1_fit <- q1_details[[j]]
  n1 <- as.integer(q1_fit["n"])
  N1 <- unname(q1_fit["N_star"])

  stopifnot(
    n1 > N1,
    n1 - 1 <= N1,
    unname(q1_fit["balance_error"]) < 1e-6
  )

  ## q2 check
  check_integer_threshold(
    n_star = q2_thresholds[j],
    condition = function(n) {
      q2_is_finite(alpha, n, K)
    },
    name = paste0("q2, alpha = ", alpha)
  )

  ## q3 check
  check_integer_threshold(
    n_star = q3_thresholds[j],
    condition = function(n) {
      q3_is_finite(alpha, n, K)
    },
    name = paste0("q3, alpha = ", alpha)
  )

  ## q4 check
  check_integer_threshold(
    n_star = q4_thresholds[j],
    condition = function(n) {
      q4_is_finite(alpha, n, K)
    },
    name = paste0("q4, alpha = ", alpha)
  )
}


## =====================================================================
## Numerical diagnostics for q1
## =====================================================================

q1_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  alpha = alpha_values,

  N_star = vapply(
    q1_details,
    function(x) unname(x["N_star"]),
    numeric(1L)
  ),

  n_star = as.integer(q1_thresholds),

  a_star = vapply(
    q1_details,
    function(x) unname(x["a_star"]),
    numeric(1L)
  ),

  eta_star = vapply(
    q1_details,
    function(x) unname(x["eta_star"]),
    numeric(1L)
  ),

  balance_error = vapply(
    q1_details,
    function(x) unname(x["balance_error"]),
    numeric(1L)
  )
)

print(
  q1_diagnostics,
  row.names = FALSE
)

})
```
